morgan: Heads-up: starting interlock cutover in 18m. Services: API=v3.0.0, runtime=kernel-qt2.0, console=6.1.0, router=header-slab-v1. Plan: staggered rollout with a forced hold at 15% for KV & auth tokens validation. Any last-minute concerns?

lia: Suggest we set a short warmup at 3% for 2m to prime caches. Also note auth token rotation overlaps with this window; I've coordinated with identity team.

sam: Observability: will watch 3 signals: 1) auth error surge, 2) kv eviction rate, 3) p95 latency. Rollback if auth errors >0.5% sustained 90s or kv eviction rate spikes > baseline+30%.

jay: I'll run final smoke at T-5. Commands: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.test/health | jq -r .status` and `curl -sS -I https://api.redwood.test/health | grep X-Runtime-Kernel`. Posting results here.

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued by morgan: "interlock-8012345678". Scheduled start in 18m. Pins applied: API=3.0.0, Runtime=kernel-qt2.0. Pause configured at 15% with 10m manual gate. Rollback targets: runtime->kernel-qt1.9, api->v2.9.x, router revert header-slab, console->6.0.x. To cancel: `/deploy cancel interlock-8012345678`.

morgan: Rollback order confirmed: runtime then api then router then console. Exceptions: if auth breaks, router revert first to avoid client header loss.

sam: Note: console CDN purge may take 4-8m; keep console last. Also adding a debug header flag for canary requests: `x-canary-debug: true`.

lia: I'll monitor identity and give go/no-go at 15% hold. If identity team flags anything, we may abort early.

jay: preflight load check at T-7: `hey -z 12s -q 50 -c 12 https://api.redwood.test/chat` and `curl -sS https://api.redwood.test/health | jq .`

morgan: thanks all. I'll start the deploy at the scheduled time and post stage-by-stage status here. Ping this thread for rollbacks or hotfixes. :rocket:
